verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a dedicated first-party 'Guarded rollouts' docs page alongside progressive rollouts and metric-type docs, which points to metric-guarded releases as a native capability. Adaptive triggers and the 'de-risking releases' positioning support automated response to regressions. Missing for 10: evidence text explicitly describing automatic rollback on regression detection, details of how regression thresholds work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
